lines.t: If you come to him, seeking grace tonight
He'll open wide, his arms of light
Though your past runs deep, your heart contrite
He'll wash you clean, make all things right
Seven times or seventy times seven
Mercy flows like rain from heaven
No soul to lust, no heart to fight
He draws you close, just as you are
He forgives the ones who call his name
Again and again, love stays the same
When you come in truth, he draws you near
With a humble heart, there's nothing to fear
If you fall again, just turn and see
His hands still wait, so patiently
A broken spirit, he won't deny
He lifts you up, he hears your cry
Every tear you shed, he sees it shine
Each plea for mercy becomes divine
When you seek his face, forgiveness flows
From crimson streams, redemption grows
He forgives the ones who call his name again and again
Love stays the same when you come in truth
He draws you near With a humble heart
There's nothing to fear
Seven times or seventy times
Still his mercy reigns from heaven
Come and rest, you're not alone
You are his and you are known
One, two, three, seventy times
Seventy times
